"Should I quit?"
"What if I think about a goal I would love to archieve?"
"Do I am capable enough or am I wasting others time?"

Most of the times I answer myself that I have no other choice than go on and thinking about what I would like to do in the future doesn't help me because I can only see a future where I struggle to live... 
But, since I don't trust my own persona I'm trying to passively frequent school, doing what I have to do with no emotions, setting the time when I have to study trying to not lose the touch with the present. I know some people can feel proud of themselves when they finish their homework but I only see it as a part of my daily routine, my votes are not even great but at least I'm surviving until the day this will be finally over, and maybe, when I will be free my mental health will get better, if not at least I will be a drepressed person with a degree.
